words.gloss_range: purpose or result particle governing the following subjunctive clause
words.prose: The opening {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes 51:33 begin in dependence on 51:32 rather than as a self-contained sentence. Its force is purpose or result: the mission is being explained by what is to be sent. Because this small particle governs the following subjunctive and is fused to the verb, it compresses the whole ayah into a clause that moves from mission purpose to agency, target, payload, and material.

topics.headline: purpose clause depends on 51:32
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that 51:33 is grammatically tied to the prior mission statement, not launched as a new independent assertion.
topics.reason: The particle is described as a purposive lam governing a subjunctive verb, and attachment evidence identifies the whole ayah as a subordinate purpose-like clause.

topics.headline: clitic binds purpose to action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that purpose is not a loose connector but is attached directly to the action-word surface.
topics.reason: The row's payoff is form-specific: the proclitic lam is written and pronounced with the following verb, so the purpose relation is compressed into one surface unit.

topics.headline: boundary marker starts the descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows a cross-ayah handoff from being sent in 51:32 to the purpose of sending stones in 51:33.
topics.reason: The rows converge on the same bridge: the ayah starts by pointing backward, then frames the sequence from agency to target, payload, and material.

words.gloss_range: cause to send or dispatch under a purpose clause, with divine first-person plural agency
words.root_gloss_range: broad sending-root range including dispatch, messenger and message vocabulary, release, easy movement, and successive movement; the local Form IV verb selects causative dispatch
words.prose: In {{ar:نُرْسِلَ}} ({{tr:nursila}}), the {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) root turns from the commissioned being-sent of 51:32 into active punishment-sending. The initial prefix carries divine first-person plural agency, Form IV gives causative dispatch, and the final vowel keeps the verb inside the purpose clause. Its frame sends upon a target with stones as explicit payload, so a root familiar from messenger and message language is narrowed here into destructive delivery. The same-surah thread keeps the contrast concrete: 51:38 sends Musa, while 51:41 sends wind as another punishment agent; even the smoother sound of the verb contrasts with the heavier payload that follows.

topics.headline: divine agency inside governed subjunctive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees both who sends and why the verb remains dependent: divine agency is encoded while the clause stays purpose-framed.
topics.reason: The prefix marks first-person plural agency, Form IV marks causative sending, and the final vowel is governed by the preceding purpose particle.

topics.headline: messenger root redirected to punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same sending-root moving from messengers and being sent to the dispatch of destructive stones.
topics.reason: The root's messenger distribution remains a real contrast, but local grammar selects a Form IV causative verb of dispatch, not a messenger noun or message sense.

topics.headline: sending upon with material payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a punishment-sending frame in which target, direct object, and material are organized by the verb rather than listed loosely.
topics.reason: The frame has an explicit object and an upon-prepositional target; the compact bundle also supports parallels to punitive sending upon targets at 7:133, 54:34, and 51:41.

topics.headline: same-surah sending chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 51:33 inside a local root-thread where sending can dispatch punishment, a prophetic envoy, or another destructive agent.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah contrasts: 51:33 sends stones, 51:38 sends Musa, and 51:41 sends wind, so the local verb participates in a surrounding sequence.

topics.headline: flowing sound suits release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small phonetic payoff: the verb sounds more flowing than the hard payload it releases.
topics.reason: The sound row is modest but concrete, and it aligns with the accepted root image of being sent forth or released without replacing the local verbal sense.

words.gloss_range: upon them or against them, with an attached known masculine plural target
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) makes the target arrive before the payload. The preposition carries both spatial descent and adversative force, while the attached pronoun retrieves the morally identified people from 51:32 as the already known target. Because the target phrase comes before the stones, the reader first hears the exposed impact zone and only afterward learns what is sent upon it.

topics.headline: descent and hostility in the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is not neutral delivery to a recipient but a descent upon and against a target.
topics.reason: The preposition is the syntactically forced complement of the sending verb and locally carries both vertical and adversative force.

topics.headline: suffix retrieves the prior people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior moral label in 51:32 become the current pronoun target without the noun phrase being repeated.
topics.reason: The suffix has no internal antecedent in 51:33 and is strongly linked by the bundle to the preceding criminal people.

topics.headline: fronted target creates impact sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the clause as target exposure first, payload disclosure second.
topics.reason: The word order places the target phrase before the direct object, making the target visible before the stones are named.

words.gloss_range: stones as an accusative, indefinite, plural payload sent upon the target
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range includes hard stone, restraint, prohibition, enclosure, sheltered custody, boundary marking, and other specialized uses; the local noun selects physical stones while restraint imagery remains secondary pressure
words.prose: {{ar:حِجَارَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ḥijāratan}}) is the accusative payload: multiple stones, concrete but indefinite, disclosed only after the target has already been fixed. The {{ar:ح ج ر}} ({{tr:ḥ-j-r}}) root selects the physical stone branch here, while the wider restraint and prohibition field sharpens the image of hard matter enforcing a boundary against the morally named people. The noun also belongs to the repeated stones-of-clay punishment formula (11:82, 15:74) and points forward to 51:34, where the payload receives marked designation; its rougher sound helps the hard object stand out after the flowing sending verb.

topics.headline: plural payload without fixed count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the stones as the explicit dispatched object, concrete and plural but not counted or made definite.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as direct object and indefinite as a broken plural, so it is payload rather than source or circumstance and remains unbounded in quantity.

topics.headline: stones-of-clay formula in 11:82 and 15:74
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the noun as part of a repeated Lot-punishment formula (11:82, 15:74), not a one-off image of generic stones.
topics.reason: The material phrase attaches to the noun and the rows explicitly compare the same stones-of-clay expression in Lot accounts such as 11:82 and 15:74.

topics.headline: physical stone with restraint pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the literal stone sense while also hearing why stone fits a judgment scene of imposed boundary and prohibition.
topics.reason: The local noun selects hard physical stones, so restraint, intellect, and prohibition senses must not replace the meaning; they survive as root-family pressure around the literal payload.

topics.headline: payload arrives after target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object as an impact disclosure: the target is heard first, then the stones, then their material.
topics.reason: The sending-upon frame selects the projectile use and the word order makes the noun pivot from target impact to material specification.

topics.headline: hard payload awaits designation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that 51:33 names the hard payload while 51:34 completes its assigned targeting status.
topics.reason: The next ayah marks the stones as designated, and the phonetic texture row gives a local sound payoff for the hardness of the payload.

words.gloss_range: from or of, marking the stones' material composition or origin
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is the hinge from projectile identity to matter. It attaches the clay phrase to the stones and keeps two physical imaginations open: composition, stones of clay, or origin, stones from clay. Its position closes the payload description after the object has been named, turns clay into charged punishment substance rather than background matter, and the doubled recitational pressure plus nasal echo make the short particle audibly bind stone to clay.

topics.headline: particle attaches material to payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle making material composition part of the stones' description rather than a separate event relation.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following genitive and attaches the material phrase to the stone noun, closing the payload description.

topics.headline: composition or origin remains open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both physical scenarios in view: clay as what the stones are made of or clay as the source from which they come.
topics.reason: Both explanatory and source readings fit the surface and differ in physical imagination without breaking the syntax.

topics.headline: sound compresses the bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the object-material link tightened at the very particle that joins the two nouns.
topics.reason: The recitational assimilation and nasal echo are local sound observations that support the tight transition from payload to substance.

topics.headline: punishment object touches creation substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short connector helps turn clay from background matter into interpretively charged punishment substance.
topics.reason: The convergence row identifies grammar, position, and sound as jointly tightening the material relation while the bridge row links the punishment object to creation-associated substance.

words.gloss_range: clay as an indefinite genitive mass substance defining the stones' material or source
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range includes clay or mud, clay coating, clay sealing, formed constitution, and a specialized expression for doing well; the local noun selects clay as material substance
words.prose: The final {{ar:طِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṭīnin}}) lands the ayah on raw material. Grammatically it is a genitive complement after the material particle, not a second object, and its singular indefinite mass form contrasts with the plural stones. The {{ar:ط ي ن}} ({{tr:ṭ-y-n}}) root selects literal clay here, but that clay carries a marked reversal: a substance familiar from creation contexts (32:7, 38:71, 7:12) becomes the material of annihilating projectiles, holding soft moldable earth under hardened impact. As the closing word, it completes the stones-of-clay formula (11:82, 15:74), supplies the ayah's elemental endpoint, and prepares for 51:34 to mark the stones' assigned target; its emphatic onset and final -in sound bind the material word to the surrounding endings.

topics.headline: raw clay as dependent material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees clay as the dependent substance defining the stones, not as a separate object or counted payload.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the material particle, indefinite, and singular as a mass substance following plural countable stones.

topics.headline: moldable clay under lethal stones
topics.reader_payoff: The reader holds together soft, moldable earth and hardened projectile force in the same material description.
topics.reason: The local sense remains literal clay as material, while the rows license a contrast between moldable earth and lethal clay-stone projectile imagery, with related baked-clay projectile language noted at 15:74 and 105:4.

topics.headline: creation clay becomes punishment clay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a distributional reversal: clay associated with human origin (32:7, 38:71, 7:12) is redeployed as the substance sent against humans.
topics.reason: The compact bundle links clay strongly with creation contexts and gives concrete contrasts such as 32:7, 38:71, 7:12, and 3:49; 51:33 uses the same substance in punishment.

topics.headline: material tag completes formula in 11:82 and 15:74
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clay word as the material tag that turns generic stones into the recognizable stones-of-clay punishment expression (11:82, 15:74).
topics.reason: The row family marks the term as both the closing element of the repeated formula (11:82, 15:74) and material carried by the sending verb.

topics.headline: elemental closure before designation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end on elemental substance while the next ayah turns that substance into assigned punishment.
topics.reason: The final word closes the sequence from agency to target to object to matter, shares the surrounding ending sound, and is followed in 51:34 by marked designation for the target class.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purposive li-, first-person plural dispatch verb, alayhim, and the material phrase hijaratan min tin.
baseline_models.mechanism: A commissioned outward motion places a hard payload onto a target, while its clay composition keeps earth and water conceptually inside the projectile rather than treating material as incidental.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release supply the payload's directed outward motion.
Material hardness supplies the compact striking body.
Mixed earth-and-water matter specifies what the hard payload is made from.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified destructive shower is sent upon a group.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a purpose-governed dispatch whose hard projectiles still carry the mixed, terrestrial character of clay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between nursila, hijaratan, and alayhim.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is released is itself an instrument of prevention and enclosure: mobility on the sender's side becomes blocked movement and closed space on the recipient's side.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the mobile first half of the reversal.
Prohibition and enclosure supply the immobilizing effect at the destination.
Clay coating supplies an adherent, space-closing material image.

changed_reading.before: The stones are only moving objects that strike.
changed_reading.after: They are mobile interdictions: released across space in order to impose a terminal boundary upon those below.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three nouns and roots permit dispatch, message, prohibition, and clay seal to overlap.
baseline_models.mechanism: The payload can be provisionally modeled as embodied communication: a dispatched, clay-sealed prohibition whose physical execution and semantic delivery coincide.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies a communicative function to the sending.
Interdiction supplies the content enacted by the hard object.
A clay seal supplies the image of authenticated closure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each stone is an executed message: dispatch, prohibition, and clay authentication compressed into one material act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agents are addressed as messengers, report that they were sent, and then state the purpose of sending the stones. Agency therefore propagates through nested dispatch: commissioner to envoys to payload to target.

activation_trace.role: The focus dispatch supplies the final operative link toward the targets.
Messenger identity supplies the delegated human-like carrier layer.
Being sent supplies the prior motion that authorizes the envoys' own sending.
A grave occurring matter supplies the scale of the commission being relayed.

structural_cues: The repeated r-s-l sequence runs from al-mursalun in 51:31 through ursilna in 51:32 to nursila in 51:33.
The li- clause makes the focus action the stated purpose of the envoys' prior dispatch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sent envoys who themselves send a payload; I supply the relay arrow and treat repeated r-s-l as delegated agency. A live alternative is that the repetitions merely restate one continuous mission without emphasizing nested transmission.

changed_reading.before: A single sender directly hurls stones at a target.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is the terminal link in a commissioned relay: authority sends envoys, envoys dispatch matter, and matter reaches the designated group.

context_deltas.mechanism: An honored guest scene first moves rich nourishment from host toward visitors, but the visitors do not consume it; their disclosed mission then moves hard, inedible earth toward another group. The focus delivery becomes an inverse return within the episode's material economy.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch supplies the visitors' counter-directional delivery.
Hard stone supplies the inedible object opposed to the offered food.
Mixed earth supplies the anti-nourishing material of the later delivery.
A guest inclining to lodge supplies the social frame of reciprocal provision.
Honor and generosity make the first material transfer a gift.
Richness and fatness supply the abundance of the offered nourishment.
Bringing near supplies the host-to-guest vector that the later dispatch reverses.
Eating supplies the expected uptake whose absence leaves the first gift suspended.

structural_cues: The food is brought near in 51:26-27, but the question about not eating marks failed uptake.
The same visitors disclose in 51:31-33 that their operative delivery is stones of clay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unconsumed generous offering followed by the guests' destructive delivery; I supply the counter-gift relation between those transfers. A live alternative is simple narrative contrast with no exchange mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The clay stones belong only to a detached punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are the visitors' anti-banquet: hard earth sent outward after rich food offered inward remains uneaten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus seed of message, interdiction, and clay seal is activated by branches for a written instrument, judgment, culpability, sovereignty, visible marking, and imposed harm. The projectiles can thus be carried as individually authenticated executions of a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies the writ-like communicative vehicle.
Interdiction supplies the binding force of the sentence.
Clay sealing supplies material authentication.
The written-document branch supplies the surprising juridical carrier image.
Judgment supplies the adjudicative frame for execution.
Culpable offense supplies the ground on which the sentence attaches.
Sovereign ownership supplies the issuing authority.
A visible identifying mark supplies individualized authentication.
The secondary mapped sense of imposed harm makes the mark operational rather than decorative.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from the s-k-k act in 51:29 through the Wise Lord in 51:30 and the mission in 51:31-33 to marked objects with the Lord in 51:34.
The marked-stone continuation immediately supplies a designation beyond the focus ayah's bare material phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies document, judgment, offense, sovereign, seal, and mark branches; I supply the legal-execution arrow that binds them into authenticated sentence-tokens. The materially live alternative is simply preselected ammunition with no juridical document metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The stones are anonymous pieces of destructive matter.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as marked, clay-sealed sentence-tokens whose delivery simultaneously communicates and executes sovereign judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those defined by cutting culpability and exceeding a limit receive objects whose focus-root can prohibit and enclose; judgment's restraining branch makes the impact a reciprocal restoration of a violated boundary.

activation_trace.role: Release carries the corrective boundary toward its recipients.
Prohibition and enclosure supply the hard limit imposed by the payload.
Restraint directed toward correction supplies the governing function of the limit.
Cutting and severance supply a target condition of broken relation.
Exceeding a bound supplies the transgression that the stone-boundary answers.

structural_cues: The target is renamed from criminals in 51:32 to limit-exceeders in 51:34.
The focus places the stone material directly alayhim, turning the semantic limit into a spatially imposed one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, severance, judgmental restraint, and enclosing stone; I supply the reciprocal arrow in which crossed limits call forth a material limit. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral and physical descriptions without reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The stonefall is force applied to wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: It materializes boundary restoration: those who overrun limits are met by a dispatched limit that encloses and terminates their movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Marking is followed by outward extraction of the secure group and identification of a single household. The focus action is therefore read as selective closure upon the remainder, not undifferentiated saturation of the inhabited place.

activation_trace.role: Directed dispatch supplies the controllable delivery stage after sorting.
An enclosed place supplies the spatial field that is closed upon the remainder.
Recognizable assignment supplies targeting before impact.
Passage outward supplies the evacuation gate preceding closure.
Security and settled trust identify the group admitted through that gate.
Exception and exclusion narrow the protected set.
The household branch supplies the single social cell extracted from the larger place.

structural_cues: Marked stones in 51:34 precede extraction in 51:35 and the count of one household in 51:36.
The focus pronoun alayhim can now resolve to the post-extraction remainder rather than every inhabitant of the place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marking, extraction, security, exception, and one household; I supply a targeting-gate mechanism in which evacuation defines the residual referent of alayhim. A live alternative is that rescue and bombardment are coordinated narratively but not by a technical sorting process.

changed_reading.before: Stones descend broadly upon a populated settlement.
changed_reading.after: They close selectively upon a residual target set constituted only after the secure household has been taken out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The episode opens as a report and ends with an intentionally remaining sign for those who anticipate punishment. Hard stone and clay seal make the focus event a medium that survives its impact and transmits warning forward.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies transmission beyond immediate impact.
Hard stone supplies a durable memory substrate.
Clay sealing supplies the impression-like preservation of the event.
A report renewed in telling supplies the episode's opening communicative state.
Leaving a trace supplies persistence after the agents and victims are gone.
A manifest sign supplies the readable status of what remains.
Anticipatory fear supplies the future audience's mode of reception.
Punitive pain supplies the warning-content carried by the remaining sign.

structural_cues: Hadith in 51:24 frames the episode as transmissible report before the focus action occurs.
51:37 explicitly converts what happened in the place into a left sign for a later audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, durable materials, an intentionally left trace, a sign, and a warning audience; I supply the arrow that treats the stone event as the archive's material inscription. A live alternative is that the sign is the ruined site or total event rather than the stones specifically.

changed_reading.before: The stones complete their function when they strike.
changed_reading.after: Their impact also writes forward: destructive matter becomes a durable archive that repeatedly delivers the warning after the original dispatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The envoys first remove immediate fear from Abraham by opening a joyful future, then their mission produces a sign that instills anticipatory fear in later observers. The focus payload becomes an affective relay that transfers fear away from the spared host and toward the warning's audience.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies the carrier for affective reassignment.
Hard impact supplies the feared consequence communicated to later observers.
Expected harm and its verbal negation supply the fear removed from Abraham.
Joy-opening news supplies the positive replacement for Abraham's fear.
Expected harm supplies the enduring response installed in the later audience.
The visible sign supplies the interface through which later fear is activated.

structural_cues: The same visitors say not to fear in 51:28 before disclosing the punitive mission.
The pericope closes in 51:37 by naming fear as the disposition that makes the remaining sign legible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear removed, glad tidings, destructive dispatch, and fear reactivated by a sign; I supply the affect-transfer arrow. A live alternative is that the two fears have different objects and merely frame the episode without being transferred.

changed_reading.before: The stones only cause fear and pain in their immediate targets.
changed_reading.after: They participate in a controlled redistribution of fear: canceled for the host, realized upon the target, and preserved as caution in future observers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch under the repeated s-l-m forms names hard stones, while other s-l-m evidence supplies safety; it remains anchored in the focus's literal hard stone and the extraction of one Muslim household. Downstream prose must present this as a branch-level lexical echo that sharpens a sorting contrast, not as a claim that the greetings or Muslim label literally mean stones here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hijaratan is the hard-stone target of an s-l-m branch activated by the doubled salam and the surviving Muslim household.

activation_trace.role: Literal hard stone anchors the branch-level echo in the focus object.
The hard-stone branch creates a startling lexical bridge from the doubled greeting to hijaratan.
Safety supplies the opposite outcome assigned to the extracted household.
Movement outward supplies the operation separating safety from stone impact.

changed_reading.before: Peace language and stone language occupy unrelated parts of the episode.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, the mission bifurcates one s-l-m field: safety is extracted with one household while hard stone is dispatched upon the remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it links the focus clay's formative branch to a promised boy, old age, barrenness, and a secondary growth branch under r-b-b; it remains anchored in tin and its formation inventory. Downstream prose must qualify it as a juxtaposed material analogy, not as an assertion that the verse identifies human creation with these particular stones.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tin carries a formation or disposition branch immediately after the envoys announce generation where age and barrenness seemed to block it.

activation_trace.role: Clay as formed disposition supplies the generative side of the material analogy.
Hard stone supplies the terminally fixed side of the contrast.
Joy-bearing news supplies the announced reversal toward life.
Youth supplies the new generative outcome.
Advanced age supplies one apparent closure of generation.
Barrenness supplies the second apparent closure that the birth announcement crosses.
The secondary mapped growth branch supplies nurture and emergence under the Lord's saying.

changed_reading.before: Clay merely describes the geology of the projectiles.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clay stands at the episode's life-or-closure threshold: formation opens toward a boy in one commission and hardens into terminal consequence in the other.

strongest_changes: Repeated r-s-l turns the focus into the last link of a delegated dispatch chain.
Clay sealing, written-instrument, judgment, culpability, sovereign, and split marking branches make the stones readable as authenticated sentence-tokens.
Limit-exceeding activates hijr as a material boundary, while extraction and one-house exception make the impact selectively post-evacuation.
The opening report and closing left sign turn hard clay from expended ammunition into a durable warning archive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact material phrase supported unusually coherent reversals: release becomes restraint, payload becomes message, and impact becomes archive. The context then supplied exact high-surprise activators, especially the clay seal with marked assignment, the s-k-k document branch, nested sending, the salām hard-stone echo, and the contrast between generative clay and terminal hardening.
remaining_uncertainties: The sealed-writ model may be a productive legal metaphor for targeted stones rather than a mechanism asserted by the syntax.
The enduring sign may be the ruined place or whole event rather than the stones themselves.
The hospitality counter-delivery, s-l-m hard-stone echo, and generation-versus-hardening model remain branch-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Released force becomes formed projectiles.** `ر س ل/B001` supplies sending/releasing; `ح ج ر/B003` hard stone; `ط ي ن/B001` earth-water clay. The purposive construction turns message-bearing envoys into agents who release material judgment. I infer **molded earth -> hardened marked unit -> dispatched impact**; hardening is inferred from the stone/clay juxtaposition, not separately stated. The verse reads as controlled manufacture and delivery.
2. **Clay as a sealing medium.** `ط ي ن/B003` supplies pressing a clay seal, activated by “marked” in 51:34 (`س و م/B004`). I infer **clay seal -> designated recipient -> nonrandom delivery**. This administrative image coexists with literal clay material.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:34's *musawwamatan* activated clay's sealing branch and corrected an image of random stones into designated, administered delivery.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Formed matter becomes a targeted dispatch.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ر س ل/B001` is sending forth; fixed `ح ج ر/B003` is “hard stone”; fixed `ط ي ن/B001` is earth and water mixed as clay, while `ط ي ن/B003` is the selected “pressing a clay seal” image. **Structural cue:** criminal harvest precedes at 51:32, and 51:34 immediately calls the stones marked and held at the Lord; extraction and a lone house then show discrimination rather than indiscriminate impact (51:35–36). **Role and abduction:** clay supplies formable matter, stone supplies hardened impact, and the seal-image prepares the next ayah’s marking; I infer that formation and marking turn matter into addressed tokens. **Reading change:** the stones read as manufactured, indexed deliveries within a sorting operation, not anonymous debris.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:34’s explicit marking activated the clay-seal branch directly, while 51:35–36’s selective extraction confirmed that the dispatch had discriminating addresses.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın, özellikle kadının, kucağını ve birinin kucağında ya da kanadı altında bulunmayı birlikte verir; yakın bedensel alan ile bu alandan gelişen koruma ilişkisi dal çerçevesinde doğru biçimde ayrılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yasaklamayı ya da yapı içindeki odayı değil, kucak alanını ve bir kişinin yakın koruması altında bulunma durumunu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kucak anlamı ile yakın koruma uzantısı tanımda ayrılır; birinin kanadı altında bulunma ve gömlek kıvrımı kullanımları kendi sözcüksel birimleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın otururken gövdesi ile bacakları arasında oluşan, birini ya da bir şeyi yakınında tutup sardığı kucak alanıdır. Bu bedensel yakınlık, birinin koruması ve denetimi altında bulunma ilişkisine de uzanır.

facets.statement: İnsanın gövdesi ile bacakları arasında, birini veya bir şeyi yakında tutmaya yarayan kucak alanıdır.
Birinin kucağında ya da kanadı altında olmak, onun yakın koruması ve denetimi altında bulunmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kucak alanını ortak çekirdek olarak verir; bir kişinin yakınında, korumasında ve denetimi altında bulunma ilişkisi bu bedensel alandan gelişen uzantıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedensel kucak alanı ile bundan gelişen koruma ilişkisini birlikte karşılamanın gerektiği genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kucak alanını ve kişinin yakın koruması altında bulunma uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birinin yakın koruması ve denetimi altında bulunduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ayın çevresindeki halka, hayvan gözünün çevresine vurulan yuvarlak damga ve göz çevresi bölgesini ortak bir çevre çizgisi ilişkisiyle birleştirir. Dal korunabilir, ancak çekirdek dönme eylemi değil bir şeyi kuşatan halka, iz veya çevre bölgesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her türlü daireselliği kapsamaz; bir nesnenin, özellikle ayın ya da gözün, çevresini belirleyen halka, iz ve bölgeyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel çevre halkası çekirdeği korunur; ay halkası, göz çevresine damga vurma, göz çevresi bölgesi ve çocuk oyunu yalnızca kendi yapılardaki kullanımlarıyla ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin, özellikle ayın ya da gözün, çevresini halka, ince çizgi veya belirgin bir bölge halinde kuşatan çevredir. Hayvan gözünün çevresine yuvarlak damga vurma eylemi bu biçimi kasıtlı olarak oluşturur.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin çevresini halka, çizgi veya belirgin bölge halinde kuşatan çevre sınırıdır.
Ayın çevresinde beliren ince halka, çevre sınırının gökyüzündeki görünümüdür.
Bir hayvanın göz çevresine yuvarlak damga vurmak, halka biçimli sınırı kasıtlı olarak oluşturma eylemidir.
Göz çukuru çevresi ile yüz örtüsünün göz çevresine oturduğu bölüm, çekirdeğin bedensel alan uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı ay çevresindeki ince halkayı, hayvan gözünün çevresine vurulan yuvarlak damgayı ve göz ya da yüz çevresindeki bölgeyi aynı çevreleme biçiminin farklı uygulamaları olarak bir araya getirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişi atı temel referent olarak verir ve onu korunan, üreme için ayrılan, seçilmiş erkek dışında çiftleştirilmeyen ya da yavru taşıyan hayvan olarak açıklar; geçici dal çerçevesi bu ortak alanı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak dişi hayvanı değil dişi atı anlatır; koruma ve damızlık için ayırma bu referentin belirgin fakat kaynaklarda farklı vurgulanan nitelikleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın sözcükteki dişi at anlamını tanımlar; koruma, damızlık için ayırma ve yavru taşıma açıklamaları aynı referentin sınırları içinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Dişi at, özellikle üreme için ayrılıp korunan ve yalnızca seçilmiş bir erkekle çiftleştirilen kısraktır. Adlandırma kaynaklarda ayrıca karnında yavru taşımasına bağlanır.

facets.statement: Referent, genel hayvan türü içinde özellikle dişi attır.
Dişi atın üreme için ayrılması, özenle korunması ve yalnızca seçilmiş bir erkekle çiftleştirilmesi belirgin yetiştirme uygulamasıdır.
Adlandırma, dişi atın karnında yavru taşıyıp onu içinde barındırmasıyla da açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar referentin dişi at olduğu konusunda birleşir; korunan ve üreme için ayrılan hayvan oluşu, seçilmiş erkek dışında çiftleştirilmemesi ve karnında yavru taşıması adlandırmayı açıklayan tamamlayıcı vurgulardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın merkezini su ile toprağın karışmasından oluşan bilinen madde olarak açıkça kurar. Ayrıca karışımın su etkisi azaldıktan sonra da aynı adla anılabildiğini, bu maddenin belirli bir parçasını ve çamurlu yer ya da zaman bildiren kullanımları destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca maddi karışımı ve ona bağlı parça ya da çamurluluk anlatımlarını kapsar; öteki dallardaki kaplama, mühürleme, yaradılış ve iyi iş yapma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel madde anlamını parça bildiren biçimden ve yalnızca belirli adlarla kurulan çamurluluk anlatımlarından ayırır; bu bağlı kullanımları bütün dalın yalın anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Su ile toprağın karışmasından oluşan, suyun etkinliği azaldıktan sonra da aynı adla anılabilen çamur maddesidir. Bu maddeden belirli bir parça ile toprağın, yerin ya da günün çamurlu oluşu ona bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, su ile toprağın karışmasından oluşan bilinen çamur maddesidir; su etkisinin azalması bu adlandırmayı zorunlu olarak ortadan kaldırmaz.

Toprağın, yerin veya günün çamuru bol ya da çamurlu oluşu yalnızca ilgili adlarla kurulan bağlı bir nitelemedir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çamuru bir yüzeye sürme ya da koyma işlemine bağlıdır; çamurla belge mühürlemeyi ve yalnızca çamur maddesini adlandırmayı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel kaplama işlemini ev ve dam gibi belirli nesnelerle kurulan anlatımlardan ve bu işin meslek adından ayırır; nesneye bağlı örnekleri sınırsız bir yalın anlam gibi genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir evin, damın veya başka bir nesnenin yüzeyine çamur koyarak onu örtme ya da kaplama işlemidir. Bu işlemin düzenli olarak yapılan işi ve mesleği de dala bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir nesnenin yüzeyine çamur koyup yayarak onu çamurla örtmek veya kaplamaktır.
Ev ve dam, çamurla kaplama işleminin açıkça tanıklanmış nesneleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynaklı ifade, bir kişinin işini iyi yapmasını ve yaptığı işin ne kadar iyi olduğunu övgüyle belirtmeyi açıkça destekler. Maddi çamur veya doğuştan yapı bu kullanımın anlamına katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişinin işini iyi yapmasını yapılan işe yönelik övgü kalıbından ayırır; tanıklanan bağlı anlatımları her bağlamda kullanılabilecek sınırsız bir yalın kök anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yaptığı işi iyi, düzgün ve beğenilir biçimde gerçekleştirmesidir. Ortaya çıkan işin ne kadar iyi yapıldığını övgüyle belirtme anlatımı da bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, kişinin yaptığı işi iyi ve beğenilir biçimde gerçekleştirmesidir.
Yapılan işin ne kadar iyi olduğunu hayranlık veya övgüyle belirtmek, temel başarı değerlendirmesinin anlatımsal uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar arasında ortaklaştırılabilecek ayrı bir malzeme yoktur; dal tek tanıklığa dayanır.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık, kişinin işini iyi yapmasını ve yaptığı işin güzelliğini övgüyle belirtmeyi birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin gerçekleştirdiği işin başarılı ve beğenilir oluşunu doğrudan karşılar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen işin niteliğini bildirir veya över; komşu dal ise kişinin iyi bildiği işe yönelmesini de içeren buyurucu bir yapı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir işin iyi gerçekleştirilmiş olmasını veya övülmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ustalık, bir işin iyi yapılmasına yol açabildiği için iki dal aynı başarı alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapılan eylemin başarısını anlatır; komşu dal ise bu başarıyı mümkün kılan kalıcı beceri ve ustalığı adlandırır.
